initialExam.title: UPSC LDCE 2026 (Limited Departmental Competitive Exam)
initialExam.description: Limited Departmental Competitive Examination conducted by UPSC for promotion of existing government employees to higher posts. Open to serving central government officers meeting eligibility criteria.
initialExam.eligibility: Serving central government employees with required years of service
initialExam.qualifications: As per specific post requirements, minimum Graduate
initialExam.syllabus: General Studies, English, concerned subject as per post. Paper pattern varies by post.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Examination (Objective + Descriptive) followed by Interview for some posts.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Interview (if applicable) → Merit List → Promotion
initialExam.jobRole: Promotion to Section Officer, Administrative Officer, and other Group B/A posts
initialExam.careerGrowth: Section Officer → Under Secretary → Deputy Secretary → Director → Joint Secretary.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Apply through department 3. Fill form 4. Submit through proper channel

salaryRange.description: Pay Level 7 to Pay Level 10 (7th CPC)

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension, LTC
